questions.prompt: How do you answer "one host or ten"?

options.b: count distinct hosts carrying the indicator with a query — sort | uniq source hosts

questions.prompt: The C2 beacon is on one host but intrusion spans four. Scope is:

options.b: relative to the question — beacon scope is 1, incident scope is 4

questions.prompt: Getting scope wrong (calling a 4-host intrusion "one host") causes:

options.b: under-scoped containment — attacker keeps other footholds
